text: AI coding agents write long transcripts, full of words like lockfile, rebase and race condition. If you are not an engineer, that is hard to follow.
Plain-English Margin underlines the jargon as you read.
Hover a word, and you get one plain sentence, written for this sentence, and why it matters here.
The badge always says which model answered, and why. This browser has no on-device model, so Gemini in the cloud answered.
Press, I know this, and the word stops being underlined.
What just happened, turns the whole thread into a short summary and numbered steps. Long text goes straight to the cloud, and the panel says so.
The words you know are listed here, and you can undo any of them.
Sync is off by default, and only ever shares that word list. Settings also show whether Gemini Nano is available in this browser.

Under the hood, one Firebase A.I. Logic model handles both paths. A router picks prefer on device for short text, and cloud only for long text. The badge reads the S.D.K.'s own inference source, and App Check protects every call.
Plain-English Margin. A Chrome extension and a web app, open source under Apache 2.0.
